description.value:
You touch a creature and mark it with a rune of death. The creature has the Cursed Condition for the duration.

Whenever the Cursed creature would receive any magical healing, it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature regains only 1 Hit Point. On a failure by 5 or more, the creature regains no Hit Points.

On a successful saving throw, the creature gains the full benefit of the magical healing and the curse ends.
